description.value: SouthEnd Farm Winery & ClearCut Distilling Co. is a small-batch winery and distillery on Quadra Island, crafting wines from organically grown grape hybrids suited to the island climate and spirits from botanicals grown or foraged on the farm. The multi-purpose tasting room doubles as the winery itself, so visitors are essentially on a farm tour the moment they walk in, with sheep, chickens, and goats nearby. A vacation 'Shack' on the property is also available for overnight stays via Airbnb, making it a potential overnight stop for cycle tourists.
